channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Animals May Have Evolved 200 Million Years Earlier Than Thought
item.description: New research indicates animals could have emerged 800 to 700 million years ago, about 200 million years earlier than some prior estimates.

item.title: Humans May Not Be Inherently Violent, Study Suggests
item.description: A study of 100 primate species, including humans, indicates that routine aggression and lethal violence did not evolve together as a single trait.

item.title: Brain activity when cannabis triggers anxiety
item.description: Cannabinoids may heighten anxiety by removing a natural brake on neurons in the brain's fear center, especially under stress.

item.title: New approach to gum disease preserves beneficial bacteria
item.description: Researchers found that disrupting bacterial chemical communication can shift dental plaque toward a healthier microbial balance.
